4
Security
Because Report Definition Language contains only metadata about the report, there are no security
considerations for the RDL file itself. Products that implement report processing using RDL as a basis
are advised, however, to account for the inherent security risks in the execution of the arbitrary Visual
Basic.Net expressions, custom code, and external class references contained within the report.
